meta.title: The Hostess Knows
meta.instructions: New kid at Ashcombe Prep, and an anonymous account is posting everyone's secrets. Tap a choice, protect your rep, collect receipts, and unmask The Hostess.

stat.body: if name == 'rep' then rep else if name == 'secrets' then secrets else if name == 'clues' then clues() else 0

atom_holds.body: let p = split(t, '>=') in if len(p) == 2 then stat(trim(get_or(p, 0, ''))) >= or_else(parse_int(get_or(p, 1, '')), 0) else contains(flags, t)

holds.body: all(split(cond, '&'), a => let t = trim(a) in t == '' or (if starts_with(t, '!') then not atom_holds(substr(t, 1, 64)) else atom_holds(t)))

is_open.body: get_or(content_story_labels, s * 3 + c, '') != '' and all(filter(content_needs, n => part(n, 0) == ckey(s, c)), n => holds(part(n, 1)))

route_of.body: fold(filter(content_routes, r => part(r, 0) == ckey(s, c)), get_or(content_story_next, s * 3 + c, ''), (acc, r) => if holds(part(r, 1)) then part(r, 2) else acc)

built_labels.body: map(range(len(content_story_labels)), i => let o = get_or(shown(i / 3), i % 3, -1) in if o < 0 then '' else get_or(content_story_labels, (i / 3) * 3 + o, ''))

built_next.body: map(range(len(content_story_next)), i => let o = get_or(shown(i / 3), i % 3, -1) in if o < 0 then '' else route_of(i / 3, o))

built_lines.body: map(range(len(content_story_lines)), i => fold(filter(content_callbacks, b => part(b, 0) == ckey(i / 4, i % 4)), get_or(content_story_lines, i, ''), (acc, b) => if holds(part(b, 1)) then part(b, 2) else acc))

fx_for.body: filter(content_effects, e => (part(e, 0) == ckey(s, c) or (c < 0 and part(e, 0) == '@' + str(s))) and holds(part(e, 3)))

toks_for.body: fold(fx_for(s, c), [], (acc, e) => concat(acc, filter(split(part(e, 1), ' '), t => t != '')))

toast_for.body: fold(fx_for(s, c), '', (acc, e) => if part(e, 2) != '' then part(e, 2) else acc)

delta.body: count(toks, t => t == '+' + name) - count(toks, t => t == '-' + name)

merged_flags.body: concat(flags, filter(toks, t => not starts_with(t, '+') and not starts_with(t, '-') and not contains(flags, t)))

receipts.body: if clues() == 0 then 'Receipts: none yet' else 'Receipts: ' + join(map(filter(flags, f => starts_with(f, 'clue_')), f => substr(f, 5, 24)), ', ')

children.text: = if get_or(story_ends, scene, '') == 'good' then 'THE END' else 'THE END?'
One of 7 endings. Try another path.

art.style: Upper East Side after dark: plum-black lacquer, blush pink and champagne gold, a striped café awning, pearls, limestone and lit townhouse windows.
